summary.text: Liz Lovelett, a Democrat from Anacortes, represents the 40th Legislative District in northern Puget Sound in the Washington State Senate. According to her official biography she was appointed to the Senate in 2019, won a special election that fall, and was elected Senate Majority Deputy Leader in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Lovelett is a fifth-generation Anacortes resident, according to her official biography, and served on the Anacortes City Council before the Senate.
The page says she has been a board member for several organizations, including Population Health Trust Skagit County, and has owned and operated a business.
The page says she was re-elected in 2020 and 2024 and is Vice Chair of the Local Government Committee, serving also on the Environment, Energy & Technology and Transportation committees.

It says she co-founded the Ferry Legislator Caucus and was appointed to the Joint Legislative Audit and Review Committee, and lists legislation she helped pass on protections for Southern Resident Killer Whales, commercial building energy efficiency, farmworker housing and the WIC program.
